entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Thank you so much for[n]today, everyone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Likewise.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You must surely be exhausted.[n]I suggest you go to sleep early.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, we should talk about[n]Haru's welcome party!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Didn't we just say we would[n]let her rest, you dimwit!?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I appreciate your concern,[n]but I'm OK. I promise.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: As long as you're OK, Haru...[n]Well, is there anywhere you'd[n]like to go?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Actually, I'd like to walk[n]around the school festival[n]with everyone.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: You mean the Shujin school[n]festival? I must admit, I[n]am interested as well.
Then it's settled.
I can't wait.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That reminds me, we still[n]haven't settled on a guest.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: A guest!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Like, some kinda celebrity!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait, does that mean the[n]Phantom Thieves could be[n]one of the candidates!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: How 'bout it? Wanna show up?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's a bit over the top...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You're getting way[n]too carried away.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't say such strange things.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What a shallow idea.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh, a four-hit combo!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry...
